reason: Independently observe async application-callback descendants without treating them as library schedules. Original rules and earlier scopes remain retained in reports.

scope.description: A callback and any finite list of preset plain values; invoke the returned function repeatedly with changed values and receivers. Include callback forwarding, results, throws, interleaved instances and no idle calls. Also pass callbacks in returned-call positions 0 through 3 and observe their synchronous invocation inside the original callback, exact identities, results and throws. Observe later descendants only through the exact async context of a verified application callback; they do not become a predicted library schedule. External triggers without context remain unsupported. Returned function custom properties are outside the boundary.
